claim.quote: An analysis of data from the PICO-60 C$_{3}$F$_{8}$ bubble chamber sets leading constraints on spin-independent absorption for dark matter masses below 23 MeV/$\textit{c}^2$ and establishes the first limits on spin-dependent absorptive interactions.

name: Absorption of Fermionic Dark Matter in the PICO-60 C$_{3}$F$_{8}$ Bubble Chamber

summary.plain: Fermionic dark matter that could be absorbed by nuclei rather than bounce off them was searched for in PICO-60 data, giving leading limits below 23 MeV and the first limits on the spin-dependent case.
summary.technical: Effective-field-theory analysis of neutral-current absorption of fermionic dark matter on nuclei using the PICO-60 C3F8 data; spin-independent limits below 23 MeV/c^2 and the first spin-dependent absorptive limits (published 2025).

title: Absorption of Fermionic Dark Matter in the PICO-60 C$_{3}$F$_{8}$ Bubble Chamber
why_it_matters: The abstract says the results demonstrate the sensitivity of bubble chambers to low-mass dark matter.
